# ADR 0004: Store masked identifiers plus HMAC, purge raw responses

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** KYC identity verification orchestrator

## Context

Data protection law requires minimisation; identity numbers are sensitive.

## Decision

Store only the last four digits and a keyed HMAC for lookups; purge raw provider payloads after 30 days.

## Consequences

Less to leak. Investigations after 30 days rely on the event summaries.

## Alternatives considered

Store everything encrypted forever.
